    TracAPI 5.1.2

    TracAPI is a Java library to read the data of TracTrac events and races: the static model (event, races, competitors, controls and routes) and the data streams (positions, control passings, race times, ...), both stored and live.

    Main concepts

    • Model (com.tractrac.model.lib.api): the objects that describe an event. An IRace is created from its parameters file using the IEventFactory, that is retrieved from the ModelLocator.
    • Subscription (com.tractrac.subscription.lib.api): the subscribers that receive the data of a race (IRaceSubscriber) or of an event (IEventSubscriber). They are created using the ISubscriberFactory, that is retrieved from the SubscriptionLocator.

    Every request needs a valid API token. The parameters file of a race is the clientparams.php URL of the race, e.g. https://em.tractrac.com/events/event_20250510_Example/clientparams.php?event=event_20250510_Example&race=RACE_UUID.

    Getting started

    This program loads a race, prints its competitors and then prints every position and control passing, both the stored ones and the live ones, until a key is pressed: 

    
import com.tractrac.model.lib.api.ModelLocator;
import com.tractrac.model.lib.api.data.IControlPassing;
import com.tractrac.model.lib.api.event.IRace;
import com.tractrac.model.lib.api.event.IRaceCompetitor;
import com.tractrac.subscription.lib.api.IRaceSubscriber;
import com.tractrac.subscription.lib.api.SubscriptionLocator;

import java.net.URI;
import java.util.Date;

public class PrintRace {

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        String apiToken = args[0];
        URI parametersURI = URI.create(args[1]);

        // 1. Load the model of the race
        IRace race = ModelLocator.getEventFactory().createRace(apiToken, parametersURI);
        System.out.println(race.getEvent().getName() + " - " + race.getName());
        for (IRaceCompetitor raceCompetitor : race.getRaceCompetitors()) {
            System.out.println("  " + raceCompetitor.getCompetitor().getShortName()
                    + " " + raceCompetitor.getCompetitor().getName());
        }

        // 2. Create a subscriber for the race and register the listeners
        IRaceSubscriber raceSubscriber = SubscriptionLocator.getSusbcriberFactory()
                .createRaceSubscriber(apiToken, race);

        raceSubscriber.subscribePositions((raceCompetitor, position) ->
                System.out.println(new Date(position.getTimestamp())
                        + " " + raceCompetitor.getCompetitor().getShortName()
                        + " " + position.getLatitude() + ", " + position.getLongitude()
                        + " " + position.getSpeed() + " km/h"));

        raceSubscriber.subscribeControlPassings((timestamp, raceCompetitor, controlPassings) -> {
            for (IControlPassing passing : controlPassings.getPassings()) {
                System.out.println(raceCompetitor.getCompetitor().getShortName()
                        + " passed " + passing.getControl().getName()
                        + " at " + new Date(passing.getTimestamp()));
            }
        });

        // 3. Start receiving the stored and the live data
        raceSubscriber.start();

        System.in.read();

        // 4. Stop the subscriber to close the connections
        raceSubscriber.stop();
    }
}

    More examples

    • Loading events and races: IEventFactory
    • Navigating the model of an event: com.tractrac.model.lib.api
    • Subscribing to positions, control passings and race times, and replaying a time window: IRaceSubscriber
    • Receiving the changes of the races and competitors of an event: IEventSubscriber
    • Knowing when the stored data has been received and when the live connection drops: IConnectionStatusListener
